title: OMIR Bundle (R1)
description: A serialized collection of OMIR resources — the on-disk '.omir' document. JSON-LD compatible: an optional '@context' enables linked-data processing without changing the core shape.

@context.description: Optional JSON-LD context. SHOULD be 'https://omir.io/spec/R1/context.jsonld' or an object that includes it.

familiaritySketch.description: EP-5b: producer-level metamemory sketch — answer 'do I plausibly hold this?' before paying for retrieval. Bundle-level (no resource OMM interaction). OMM-0.

entry.description: The resources carried by this bundle. Order is not significant; references resolve by 'ResourceType/id'.
